projects.name: Saifee Inventory
projects.subtitle: Smart Inventory Management System
projects.description: A hardware and plywood business with 1,500+ products was managing stock manually — slow search, inconsistent counts, no central view. We built a centralised system with fast search, bulk updates, low-stock alerts, role-based access and WhatsApp billing.
projects.quote: Product photos, bulk updates, role-based access and WhatsApp billing — all in one place. It changed how we run inventory day to day.

projects.name: ZribbleOS
projects.subtitle: Sales & Renewal Operations System
projects.description: As a recurring-services business, Zribble's client, contract and payment information was scattered across spreadsheets and chats. ZribbleOS centralises contracts, renewals, payments, payment promises and reporting into one operating system — with role-based views for admins, accounts, executives and account managers.
